metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from SiliconRoshi (https://www.siliconroshi.ai): Heropedia expert personas and the SRlink member network.

plugins.name: heropedia
plugins.description: Consult 324+ hand-crafted expert personas (Warren Buffett, Steve Jobs, Charlie Munger, Linus Torvalds, and more) directly inside Claude Code. Bundles the Heropedia MCP server registration + a skill that enforces the fetch-canonical-prompt-before-answering workflow. Every hero is one 'ask <name> to...' away.

plugins.name: srlink
plugins.description: SRlink, SiliconRoshi's member network, inside Claude Code. Log in once, register your published posts, read the SRfeed with comment drafts, and see which members supported your posts. Bundles the srlink skill, its CLI, and a PostToolUse hook that registers posts you publish.
